literal_meaning: কাজ বা ব্যবহারে আসা বা লাগা (work/use-এ come or apply)
figurative_meaning_en: To be useful when needed, to yield benefit
example_sentences_in_english: These tools will come in handy later.
His advice is proving useful now.
note: This idiom emphasizes resourcefulness in Bengali culture, often used in contexts of thrift and preparedness.
